department: Department of Mechanical and Nuclear Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog gives January 15 for fall entry.

gre_general.value: The catalog requires GRE results; the minimum score is set each year by the program committee.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
